## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Zero invasive risk across 12 regions and clear simulated margins [F7] (Tier 1: surgical frozen section).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, others 0% (risk 0%) [F1] | Calibrated; test ECE 5% (n=132) |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% test coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 76th percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Unflagged despite level-3 stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%), 1/5 Normal [F5] | Nearest neighbors match benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.81, contribution -1.21) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.69, contribution -0.73; caption-inconsistent) favors benign [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.05, contribution +0.44) slightly raises invasive score [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score (contribution +0.40); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Mild score (+0.33, contribution +0.23); 8/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier (top-3 deletion drop +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); discount unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation (76th-percentile OOD) masks subtle invasion or margin tumor; reliability error AUROC is 70%.
- Tissue is Normal (contrast case BACH_0381, 85% similar, differs in pleomorphism and benign_stroma_fat); cell segmentation disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 5, 9**: Confirm benign tubule architecture despite caption-inconsistent text scoring and severity-3 stain degradation.
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Verify benign stroma in 7 and absent stromal invasion or pleomorphism in 11.
3. **Regions 8, 11**: Inspect inferior, medial, and lateral frozen-section margins where segment risk reaches 1%.
